en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਕੀ ਚਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: kutaa raaj bahaaleeaai fir chakee chaTai|

en.bdb: If a dog is seated on the throne even then it will (like to) lick the flour mill.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਲੀਐ ਵਿਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: sapai dhudh peeaaleeaai vih mukhahu saTai|

en.bdb: If a snake is fed on milk even then it will pour out poison from its mouth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਰਖੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਘਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: pathar paanee rakheeaai man haTh na ghaTai|

en.bdb: If a stone is kept in water even then its hardness does not soften.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਪਰਿਹਰੈ ਖਰੁ ਖੇਹ ਪਲਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: choaa cha(n)dhan pariharai khar kheh palaTai|

en.bdb: Repudiating the perfume and sandalwood-fragrance, the donkey rolls its body in the dust.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਪਰ ਨਿਦਹੁੰ ਹਠਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: tiau ni(n)dhak par nidhahu(n) haTh mool na haTai|

en.bdb: Similarly the backbiter never gives up (his habit of) backbiting

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੜ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਟੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit_en: aapan hathee aapanee jaR aap upaTai ||1||

en.bdb: And uproots himselt to destroy his very existence.
